Rust crates compiled into the WebAssembly module that Spark 2.4.0 embeds
(@sparkjsdev/spark dist/spark.module.js), and therefore into
assets/spatial_viewer/viewer.bundle.js.

Method: the module's embedded source paths (panic locations) name every crate
below, with the exact version. Licences are the ones the crates.io registry
publishes for that exact version, read on 2026-11-22. The list is a floor: a
crate that carries no panic path would not appear in it. Spark's own Rust code
(rust/spark-lib, rust/spark-rs) is MIT, see SPARK-MIT.txt.

anyhow 1.0.98                  MIT OR Apache-2.0
console_error_panic_hook 0.1.7 Apache-2.0 OR MIT
fdeflate 0.3.7                 MIT OR Apache-2.0
flate2 1.1.10                  MIT OR Apache-2.0
hashbrown 0.16.1               MIT OR Apache-2.0
image 0.25.10                  MIT OR Apache-2.0
image-webp 0.2.4               MIT OR Apache-2.0
indexmap 2.13.0                Apache-2.0 OR MIT
js-sys 0.3.94                  MIT OR Apache-2.0
memchr 2.7.6                   Unlicense OR MIT
png 0.18.1                     MIT OR Apache-2.0
ruzstd 0.9.1                   MIT
serde 1.0.228                  MIT OR Apache-2.0
serde_core 1.0.228             MIT OR Apache-2.0
serde-wasm-bindgen 0.6.5       MIT
serde_json 1.0.145             MIT OR Apache-2.0
smallvec 1.15.1                MIT OR Apache-2.0
wasm-bindgen 0.2.117           MIT OR Apache-2.0
zip 7.2.0                      MIT
zlib-rs 0.6.3                  Zlib

Every dual-licensed crate is used here under its MIT option. The MIT-only
crates (ruzstd, serde-wasm-bindgen, zip) and the MIT option of the others
require their copyright notice to travel with copies; each crate's notice is in
its published source package on crates.io, and the project names above are
the upstream authors' work. zlib-rs is under the Zlib licence, which requires
no notice for binary distribution. Nothing in the list is copyleft.
